question: Chittaranjan Das was the political guru of which of the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Chandra Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On January 23, 1897, **Subhash Chandra Bose** was born in** Cuttack, Orissa Division, Bengal Province**.
 
• The 23rd of January is observed as "**Parakram Diwas**," the anniversary of** Netaji's **birth.
 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose** is more commonly referred to as "**Netaji**."
 
• **Vivekananda's** teachings had a significant impact on him, and he regarded him as his spiritual teacher.
 
• The "**Political Guru of Subhash Chandra Bose**" was** Chittaranjan Das.**
 
• At the **Tripuri Session in 1939** and the **Haripura Session in 1938, **he was the first** INC President **to be elected.
 
• In 1939, he created the **Forward Bloc**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chittaranjan Das**

 
 
• **​Chittaranjan Das**, also known as **Deshbandhu** (Friend of the Nation), was an **Indian freedom fighter**, political activist, and lawyer during the **Indian Independence Movement.**
 
• He also founded and served as the **leader of the Swaraj Party** in undivided Bengal during the time of **British Colonial rule in India. Chittaranjan Das** passed away on June 16, 1925.
 
• He goes by the initials** C. R. Das**. In addition to several articles and essays, he was closely affiliated with a number of literary clubs and composed poetry.
